purpose: Mach-O x86-64 / ARM64 thin lanes (test-estate phase 4, real-binary R4)
why: Mach-O was one tracked x86-64 sample with no ARM64 and no decompiler-semantic coverage. The same three functions at both architectures make the ABI the only variable, which is how `mix_float` was found: x86-64 recovers `double(double,float)` exactly while ARM64 recovered `void(void)`.
